title: 列車自動防護系統~Automatic train protection systems
focus: 制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態~Braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states
summary: 列車自動防護系統以「制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。列車自動防護把速度位置、路線許可及制動能力組成可持續檢查的包絡，離線算例只解釋邊界，不能作可上線的安全控制器。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把列車自動防護系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。列車自動防護把速度位置、路線許可及制動能力組成可持續檢查的包絡，離線算例只解釋邊界，不能作可上線的安全控制器。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Automatic train protection systems in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s；y=v*t=36 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=39.6 m。模型邊界：延遲期間速度固定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s; y=v*t=36 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=39.6 m. Boundary: Fixed speed during the delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 常減速度停距~Constant-deceleration stop distance
units.title: 常減速度停距~Constant-deceleration stop distance
units.mechanism: 動能關係使停距隨速度平方增長。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 726 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平常減速度且無建立延遲。使用速度衰減與制動建立作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Energy balance makes stopping distance grow with speed squared. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 726 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay. Use speed decay and brake build-up as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以速度衰減與制動建立區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度軌跡與時間積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「常減速度停距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use speed decay and brake build-up to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed trace and time integration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Constant-deceleration stop distance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求。這個失效與「常減速度停距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度衰減與制動建立，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance. This failure and a measurement bias in Constant-deceleration stop distance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed decay and brake build-up rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance.
units.practice: 重算「常減速度停距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出水平常減速度且無建立延遲如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度衰減與制動建立說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Constant-deceleration stop distance, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring build-up and gradient understates required distance. Explain which evidence in speed decay and brake build-up distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 處理延遲行程~Processing-delay travel
units.mechanism: 判定與作動延遲期間仍持續前進。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 39.6 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲期間速度固定。使用端到端時戳與速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均延遲不可替代有界最壞延遲，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Travel continues during decision and actuation delay. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 39.6 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed speed during the delay. Use end-to-end timestamps and speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mean delay cannot replace a bounded worst-case delay; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.verify: 本單元以端到端時戳與速度區分模型與觀察，先用離線故障注入與共同時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「處理延遲行程」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use end-to-end timestamps and speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 坡度等效減速~Gradient-adjusted deceleration
units.mechanism: 下坡重力分量抵消部分制動減速度。本模型把 abrake 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.7819 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小均勻坡度及固定制動力。使用坡度位置與制動力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；坡度符號反向會高估可用減速，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Downhill gravity offsets part of the braking deceleration. In this model, abrake is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.7819 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small uniform gradient and fixed braking force. Use gradient location and braking force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Reversing gradient sign overstates available deceleration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：abrake=0.8 m/s2, g=9.81 m/s2, downhill=0.01 1；y=abrake-g*downhill=0.7019 m/s2。只把 abrake 增加百分之十，y=0.7819 m/s2。模型邊界：小均勻坡度及固定制動力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: abrake=0.8 m/s2, g=9.81 m/s2, downhill=0.01 1; y=abrake-g*downhill=0.7019 m/s2. Boundary: Small uniform gradient and fixed braking force; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.anchor: 距離反算速度~Distance-based speed inversion
units.title: 距離反算速度~Distance-based speed inversion
units.mechanism: 距離反算速度必須與同一制動假設一致。本模型把 a 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.7489 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。常減速度且已另扣延遲與餘量。使用距離與減速假設作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；將此縮減速度當完整允許速度會漏掉多重限制，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Inverted speed must use the same braking assumptions as the distance model. In this model, a is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.7489 m/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant deceleration after separately removing delay and reserves. Use distance and deceleration assumptions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating this reduced speed as full permitted speed omits other constraints; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：a=0.7 m/s2, d=500 m；y=sqrt(2*a*d)=26.4575 m/s。只把 a 增加百分之十，y=27.7489 m/s。模型邊界：常減速度且已另扣延遲與餘量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: a=0.7 m/s2, d=500 m; y=sqrt(2*a*d)=26.4575 m/s. Increasing only a with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.7489 m/s. Boundary: Constant deceleration after separately removing delay and reserves; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以距離與減速假設區分模型與觀察，先用紙上反算及正向停距驗算建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「距離反算速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use distance and deceleration assumptions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paper inversion and forward stop-distance check, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Distance-based speed inversion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 將此縮減速度當完整允許速度會漏掉多重限制。這個失效與「距離反算速度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查距離與減速假設，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Treating this reduced speed as full permitted speed omits other constraints. This failure and a measurement bias in Distance-based speed inversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check distance and deceleration assumptions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

In this model, bias is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed scale bias rather than random walk. Use radius calibration and position-reference reset as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Slip error is not fully described by a fixed scale factor; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

In this model, bits is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 32 states. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. units.anchor: 速度量化半格差~Speed quantization half-step
units.title: 速度量化半格差~Speed quantization half-step
units.mechanism: 四捨五入量化誤差上界與解析度相連但不含感測偏差。本模型把 resolution 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0763889 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想最近值四捨五入。使用原始速度與顯示速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Rounding quantization error is bounded by resolution but excludes sensor bias. In this model, resolution is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0763889 m/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal rounding to the nearest displayed value. Use raw and displayed speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：resolution=0.5 km/h；y=resolution/2/3.6=0.0694444 m/s。只把 resolution 增加百分之十，y=0.0763889 m/s。模型邊界：理想最近值四捨五入；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: resolution=0.5 km/h; y=resolution/2/3.6=0.0694444 m/s. Increasing only resolution with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.0763889 m/s. Boundary: Ideal rounding to the nearest displayed value; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以原始速度與顯示速度區分模型與觀察，先用合成慢速掃描與誤差圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度量化半格差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use raw and displayed speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic slow sweep and error plot, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Speed quantization half-step. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度。這個失效與「速度量化半格差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始速度與顯示速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty. This failure and a measurement bias in Speed quantization half-step can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw and displayed speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty.
units.practice: 重算「速度量化半格差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想最近值四捨五入如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始速度與顯示速度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Speed quantization half-step, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal rounding to the nearest displayed value. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty. Explain which evidence in raw and displayed speed distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
